regions.merged_text: Of course, I know that you have been doing a lot of charity-work these past years and I have thanked God to see it. It indicates to me at least, that you have more faith and more charity than many would like to concede. After all, however, rightly ordered charity begins at home. That means, in my figuering at least, the cultivation and fostering in our own individual hearts and souls the supernatural virtues of faith, hope and charity - essencially one virtue. In other words I might say it means for me personally, that I should strive continually to learn more and more about God my Creator, about God as my Redeemer, about God my Sanctifyer. Because in only as much as I know anything can I appreciate it. as I know a good person can I love him. In only as much Herein God Himself will be no exception. He wants, therefore, to be known in order that He may be intelligently loved. Therefore, the catechism puts knowledge of God first: "God made me to know Him; which means and includes all the rest - to love Him and serve Him. Hence the little verses, which I think you will like. Let them be a simple conclusion.
